title: Refund Settlement on Stays: Destination, Component Limits and Payout Stage
content:
# Refund settlement

**Destination.** Every refund on a reservation in the Stays (Guest Reservations) category is sent to the refund destination of the stay's policy — the guest's original payment method — and the card issuer posts it within the policy's posting time in business days. Roamhaven never pays a stay refund in cash, travel credit or to another card.

**Per component.** A refund is posted per charge component, as a positive amount, and never exceeds the amount of that component collected on the stay net of earlier refunds of it.

**Payout stage.** The stage of a refund is before payout release when no release of the host's earnings for the stay is on record in the Payout Methods ledger at the moment of the refund, and after payout release otherwise.

**Funding by the host.** A refund funded by the host is one that reduces the host's earnings for the stay. When such a refund is after payout release, the host's share is recovered from the host's future payouts and the host service fee on it is refunded, under the Payout Methods and Host Accounts rules.

## Stage and funding table

| Earnings release for the stay on record at the moment of the refund | Stage | Funded by host | Funded by platform |
|---|---|---|---|
| none | before payout release | reduces the host's earnings for the stay | borne by Roamhaven |
| present | after payout release | host's share recovered from future payouts; host service fee on it refunded | borne by Roamhaven |

## Component limit (hypothetical ledger)

A hypothetical stay collected 300.00 of cleaning fee and an earlier refund of 120.00 of cleaning fee is on its ledger. Any further cleaning-fee refund on that stay is at most 180.00, the amount collected net of the earlier refund.
